## Summary

Describe the user-visible or registry-visible outcome.

## Upstream and Foldkit evidence

- shadcn/ui source and commit:
- Foldkit primitive or example:

## Quality dimensions

- [ ] Visual states reviewed in light and dark modes
- [ ] Keyboard, focus, and accessible naming verified
- [ ] Behavior and parent/child message mapping tested
- [ ] Composition and source ownership remain clear
- [ ] Documentation examples and API metadata updated
- [ ] Registry dependencies and clean install verified

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run test:browser` when UI or docs behavior changed
- [ ] `npm run test:registry` when registry, dependencies, or generated adapters changed
- [ ] Changelog and parity contracts updated when applicable
